--- title: "Tableau de bord — Anthropic Economic Index" format: dashboard: orientation: rows scrolling: true nav-buttons: - icon: github href: https://github.com/albanpjy/aei-analyse aria-label: Dépôt GitHub theme: light: [cosmo, ../theme/clair.scss] dark: [cosmo, ../theme/sombre.scss] execute: echo: false --- # Vue d'ensemble ## Row {height=22%} ::: {.cell content='valuebox' title='Indice d\'usage par habitant — France'} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $icon [1] "person-workspace" $color [1] "primary" $value [1] "3,97" ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell content='valuebox' title='Rang mondial de la France (indice par habitant)'} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $icon [1] "trophy" $color [1] "secondary" $value [1] "10e / 121" ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell content='valuebox' title='Part d\'automatisation (Claude.ai, monde)'} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $icon [1] "robot" $color [1] "warning" $value [1] "48,6 %" ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell content='valuebox' title='Pays dans la dernière version'} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` $icon [1] "globe" $color [1] "info" $value [1] 121 ``` ::: ::: ## Row {height=78%} ### Column {width=60%} ::: {.cell title='Indice d\'usage par habitant dans le monde (dernière version)'} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Column {width=40%} ::: {.cell title='Classement (indice par habitant)'} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: # Pays (interactif) ## {.sidebar} ```{ojs} //| echo: false // Liste SQL des pays choisis. Les codes viennent de la liste proposée (valeurs // sûres) ; on évite de lier un tableau JS comme paramètre, mal pris en charge // par certaines versions de DuckDB-WASM. liste_sql = (codes) => codes.map(c => `'${String(c).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`).join(", ") || "''" // DuckDB-WASM : une base DuckDB complète, exécutée DANS le navigateur, qui lit // les fichiers Parquet publiés avec le site. Aucun serveur. db = DuckDBClient.of({ usage: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/usage_pays.parquet"), automatisation: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/automatisation.parquet"), soc: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/soc_pays.parquet"), taches: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/taches.parquet"), pays: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/pays.parquet") }) versions = (await db.query("SELECT DISTINCT release FROM usage ORDER BY release")).map(d => d.release) liste_pays = (await db.query(`SELECT DISTINCT u.geo_id, coalesce(p.country_name, u.geo_id) AS nom FROM usage u LEFT JOIN pays p ON p.iso_alpha_3 = u.geo_id ORDER BY nom`)) viewof version = Inputs.select(versions, {label: "Version de l'index", value: versions[versions.length - 1]}) viewof choix_pays = Inputs.select(new Map(liste_pays.map(d => [d.nom, d.geo_id])), { label: "Pays (Ctrl/Cmd pour plusieurs)", multiple: true, size: 10, value: ["FRA", "DEU", "GBR", "ESP", "ITA", "BEL", "NLD", "USA"] }) ``` ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} Filtres calculés dans votre navigateur par **DuckDB-WASM** sur les fichiers Parquet du site. Données d'**usage** de Claude, pas d'emploi. ::: ## Row ```{ojs} //| title: "Indice d'usage par habitant (version choisie)" aui = db.query(`SELECT u.geo_id, coalesce(p.country_name, u.geo_id) AS nom, avg(u.aui) AS aui, any_value(u.origine_aui) AS origine FROM usage u LEFT JOIN pays p ON p.iso_alpha_3 = u.geo_id WHERE u.release = ? AND u.geo_id IN (${liste_sql(choix_pays)}) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY aui DESC`, [version]) Plot.plot({ marginLeft: 130, height: Math.max(220, 26 * aui.length), x: {label: "Indice (1 = proportionnel à la population 15–64 ans)", grid: true}, y: {label: null}, marks: [ Plot.barX(aui, {y: "nom", x: "aui", sort: {y: "-x"}, rx: 2, fill: d => palette[d.geo_id] ?? "#c3c2b7", tip: true, title: d => `${d.nom}\nIndice : ${d.aui.toLocaleString("fr-FR", {maximumFractionDigits: 2})} (${d.origine})`}), Plot.ruleX([1], {stroke: "#898781", strokeDasharray: "4,3"}) ] }) ``` ```{ojs} //| title: "Part d'automatisation (Claude.ai), toutes versions" auto = db.query(`SELECT a.release, a.geo_id, coalesce(p.country_name, a.geo_id) AS nom, avg(a.automatisation_pct) AS auto FROM automatisation a LEFT JOIN pays p ON p.iso_alpha_3 = a.geo_id WHERE a.source = 'claude_ai' AND a.geo_level = 'country' AND a.geo_id IN (${liste_sql(choix_pays)}) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY a.release`) Plot.plot({ height: 320, x: {type: "point", label: "Version"}, y: {label: "Automatisation (%)", grid: true}, color: {legend: true, domain: [...new Set(auto.map(d => d.nom))], range: [...new Set(auto.map(d => d.geo_id))].map(g => palette[g] ?? "#898781")}, marks: [ Plot.line(auto, {x: "release", y: "auto", stroke: "nom", strokeWidth: 2}), Plot.dot(auto, {x: "release", y: "auto", fill: "nom", r: 4, tip: true, title: d => `${d.nom} — ${d.release}\n${d.auto.toLocaleString("fr-FR", {maximumFractionDigits: 1})} %`}) ] }) ``` ## Row ```{ojs} //| title: "Tâches les plus fréquentes (premier pays sélectionné, version choisie)" taches = db.query(`SELECT tache, part_pct FROM taches WHERE release = ? AND geo_id = ? ORDER BY part_pct DESC LIMIT 15`, [version, choix_pays[0] ?? "FRA"]) Inputs.table(taches, { columns: ["tache", "part_pct"], header: {tache: "Tâche O*NET", part_pct: "Part (%)"}, format: {part_pct: d => d.toLocaleString("fr-FR", {maximumFractionDigits: 2})}, width: {tache: 520}, rows: 15 }) ``` # Automatisation ## Row ::: {.cell title='Automatisation mondiale par version et par source (survol pour le détail)'} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
